scope: Post-hoc inspection of three actual indexed analogue candidates, not independent policy calibration or experimentally demonstrated negative chemistry. The performed source reaction is checked; applicability to the generated substrate remains unresolved and no TierB/D is assigned.

records.locator: Named preparation around normalized offset678382, not the later iodination or substituted-compound activity table.
records.source_conditions: 5-Bromo-4-chloro azaindole500 mg/2.16 mmol and sodium thiomethoxide151 mg/2.16 mmol in DMF5 mL,80 C15 h; add75 mg/1.08 mmol thiomethoxide and heat2 h more. Water50 mL precipitates524 mg, reported>99%, with NMR/MS. Water is workup and sodium is the explicitly reported thiolate counterion, not an extra covalent substrate.
records.structural_reconciliation: Independently transcribed N-first pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridine with C5-Br and C4-Cl changing to C4-SMe, retaining ring NH. Primary named product agrees with the indexed candidate's covalent structure; its extracted Na/water components are retained separately as known roles rather than silently treated as covalent substrates.
records.unresolved_applicability: The generated reaction substitutes at indole C3 and retains a chloro/hydroxyethyl-substituted benzofused ring. The performed candidate instead substitutes C4 of an azaindole with an additional six-membered-ring nitrogen. The local radius1 edit match does not establish equivalent electronic activation or reaction behavior across these different ring positions. No source experiment on the generated indole is supplied; this is not proof that its transformation is impossible.
records.decision: retain_C_unresolved_not_D; performed source is real but strong-analogue applicability is not established

records.locator: Example53 step1 around normalized offset242189, referencing the actual thiolate substitution in Example47 step2 around230000; not later oxidation to a sulfone.
records.source_conditions: Example53 step1:3,5-dibromoanisole5.3 g/19.93 mmol and sodium1-propanethiolate2.47 g/23.92 mmol, following Example47 step2's DMF105 C2 h and aqueous/extraction/chromatography workup. Isolated2.01 g,39%, light yellow oil, HRMS. No copper/palladium catalyst is introduced into the source recipe by inference.
records.structural_reconciliation: The source substitutes one of the two symmetry-equivalent bromides of3,5-dibromoanisole with n-propylthio and retains OMe and the other bromide. Sodium is the reported thiolate counterion. Product and essential covalent substrates were transcribed independently from the source names.
records.unresolved_applicability: The query uses4-bromochlorobenzene and aminoethylthiolate rather than dibromoanisole and n-propylthiolate. A free primary amine, different aryl substitution and unspecified counterion/condition compatibility are not tested by this specific preparation. The paper/patent demonstrates a real aryl-thioether formation but not selectivity or tolerance for the generated aminoethyl substrate. Retain unknown rather than declare a competing N-arylation experimentally observed.
records.decision: retain_C_unresolved_not_D; actual source experiment does not establish the generated substrate's compatibility

records.checked_passage: give phenyl acetate, 2.27 g., 98%, b.p. 110°/58 mm.
records.locator: Example11, thallous phenoxide formation and subsequent acetyl chloride O-acylation, around normalized offset107000; not the separate beta-dicarbonyl O-acylation claims.
records.source_conditions: Thallous phenoxide5 g/0.017 mole in anhydrous ether15 mL, freshly distilled acetyl chloride1.33 g/0.017 mole in ether3 mL added over5 min, room temperature1 h. Filter precipitated thallous chloride, evaporate and distill phenyl acetate2.27 g,98%, bp110 C/58 mm. This is the actual organothallium salt procedure, not a generic metal-free phenoxide experiment.
records.structural_reconciliation: The source phenoxide O is acetylated; acetyl chloride contributes the acyl group and Tl(I) is an explicit counterion yielding TlCl. The indexed computational structure omits that counterion, which is restored only as a separately reported source condition here, not silently added to the generated reaction.
records.unresolved_applicability: The generated precursor is a substituted dihydroquinoline phenoxide with a protonated ring nitrogen, an ester and aryl I/Cl groups. The original experiment uses simple thallous phenoxide and cannot establish this ionic/protonation context or the generated substrate's full functional-group tolerance. It is real O-acylation precedent, but those compatibility questions remain open. No failed forward experiment or direct contradiction is claimed.
records.decision: retain_C_unresolved_not_D; counterion and generated substrate context remain unverified
